contexts.text: The desire of men to inquire into the mysteries of faith by means of sensuous and scientific things, was the cause not only of the fall of the Most Ancient Church, that is, of its posterity; but it is also the cause of the fall of every Church; for thence come not only falsities, but also evils of life. AC 205, Explained.
To build = to build up that which is fallen.
(Otherwise) the Lord would have had to come into the world immediately after the fall of the Most Ancient Church.
By the fall, the natural man began to raise himself above the spiritual, and thus inverted Divine order itself...
Of himself, man is continually falling...

When that Church had fallen, which was effected by means of reasonings from scientifics concerning Divine truths... The first state after the fall of that Church is that which is here described. AC 9960:20.
The sole cause of men being lower than the brutes is the fall of Adam. Explained.
Immediately after the fall, the hinge of the intellectual mind was reversed...
On the fall of Angels from Heaven.
Falls, and other misfortunes (are caused by evil Spirits).
When they see that a man is falling, they help in every possible way to make him fall headlong.
In the thought of his fall...
(They say that) by the fall of Adam, freewill, which is the freedom of doing what is good of one's self, was destroyed.
